verdict.line: You lose if you facetank Rupture poke and extend trades into Vorpal Spikes stacks before level 6; you win if you wall off his Q, hit 6 first, and burst him with the Maiden before his Feast stacks pile up.

brief.thesis: Cho'Gath's Q (Rupture) pokes and zones you for free at range 1-5 with no reliable answer from your kit, but once your R (Eulogy of the Isles) comes online at 6 the Maiden's bonus damage lets you punish him before Feast stacks make him a long-term threat. The 51.4% win rate over 146 games and Yorick's solo-kill advantage both point to a lane you can flip with timing rather than raw stats.

theirWindow.what: Back off minion aggro until it's down. If it lands, expect him to walk in for W (Feral Scream, 300 range, silence) next — use E's slow or W's wall to buy space before he silences you into free Vorpal Spikes.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, R and a grave or two banked
yourWindow.what: Mark him with E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred and slow, summon the Maiden, then land Q (Last Rites) for the empowered attack — your hits on his Maiden-marked body deal bonus damage, which is your best burst window before his Feast stacks pile up.

start.why: 54.2% win rate over 83 games — the extra HP and block-on-hit absorb his Vorpal Spikes chip and Rupture poke so you can stay in minion range to bank Last Rites grave value.

boots.why: 57.8% win rate over 90 games — the tenacity cuts the duration of his Feral Scream (W) silence, which is the setup he needs before he can safely stack Vorpal Spikes on you.

core.why: Builds your empowered-attack damage and mobility so you can actually catch him after a Rupture knockup instead of eating the slow.
The armor shred stacks with your E's own armor reduction, which matters once he's stacked Feast and is sitting on raw HP.
Cooldown reduction on Last Rites and Mourning Mist lets you re-apply the mark and empowered auto faster in extended trades — this path ran 50% over 6 games, the strongest sampled core.

situational.when: you're split-pushing uncontested in the 14-18 window and need to break towers before he can walk over
he's stacked several Feast kills and the extra armor pen plus slow is needed to pin him down for the all-in
you want a shield proc on your all-in combo to survive the trade back from Feral Scream and Vorpal Spikes
teamfights are forming and you need to slow him out of Rupture range before he can zone your team

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on your empowered Last Rites auto in extended trades and gives sustain that offsets his Rupture poke, which is why this page runs 60.8% win rate at 26.2% pick — the highest sampled. Master-tier Yorick players instead favor Conqueror (1,068 games) if you'd rather trade aggression for the all-in burst window at level 6 than grind out slow poke trades.

summoners.why: 52.7% win rate at 56.4% pick — the most-run setup, and it fits Yorick's identity since your 14-18 power spike comes from split-pushing with the wall and graves, which Teleport lets you leverage across the map. Flash+Ignite (53.1%, 32.8% pick) is the better pick if you want to force the early kill before his Carnivore sustain and Feast stacks come online.

playing.title: Wall off Rupture
playing.detail: Cho'Gath's Q (Rupture) is ground-targeted at 950 range on a 9s cooldown — watch the cast and either sidestep or drop W (Dark Procession)'s wall to block the zone when you're pushed up on minions.

playing.title: Trade with E before autos
playing.detail: Throw Mourning Mist (E, 700 range) to mark and slow him before you walk into Vorpal Spikes range — his E triggers passively on every attack at melee range, so closing in without the mark means eating free spike stacks.

playing.title: Don't Q into silence range
playing.detail: Feral Scream (W) only reaches 300 range in a cone and silences for a few seconds on a 13s cooldown — if he's closed to that distance, expect it, and hold Last Rites (Q) until the silence window passes.

playing.title: Bank graves off minions
playing.detail: Last Rites (Q) only digs a grave on champions, large monsters, or a killing blow — land it on minion kills near him during trades so you're stacking graves for Maiden summons later.

playing.title: All-in the instant R is up
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles grants bonus damage on your attacks against the Maiden's target and auto-raises walkers from kills — use it the moment it comes online at 6 to burst him down before his Feast stacks compound.

playing.title: Respect Feast execute range
playing.detail: Feast (R) deals high true damage at 175 range on a 60s cooldown and can finish you while growing his max HP on the kill — disengage before you're low enough for it to be lethal rather than trading for the last bit of damage.

playing.title: Split with the wall late
playing.detail: By level 14+ Dark Procession's cooldown drops to 12s, letting you block pursuers repeatedly — prioritize split-pushing so he either gives up farm or walks into your grave and Maiden stacks alone.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and the 51.4% win rate over 146 games are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch; the ability readings and lane-timing calls are my own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid his (Q) while poking with [E]. His (P) gives him a lot of health so try to kill him quickly by poking often. Use [R] after reaching level 6 to deal damage. Be careful of being low on health as he can use (R) to kill you.
